# Script Shadow

> > A comprehensive screenwriting resource and AI-powered feedback platform for writers seeking professional script analysis and industry insights.

Script Shadow, founded by Carson Reeves, provides screenplay reviews, script consultation services, and in-depth analysis of storytelling craft. The site combines traditional screenwriting education with modern AI tools to help writers improve their craft and understand what works in professional scripts.

## Key Topics

- Screenplay Review
- Script Analysis
- Screenwriting Craft
- Character Development
- Dialogue Improvement
- AI in Writing
- Black List
- Script Notes
- Carson Reeves
- Creative Process
- Writing Tools
- AI for Writers
- Movie Review
- Script Consultation
- Storytelling

## Core Services

- [Script Shadow](https://scriptshadow.net): Script Shadow homepage featuring AI writing tools and screenwriting resources
- [Script Notes](https://scriptshadow.net/script-notes): Professional screenplay consultation and feedback service by Carson Reeves
- [About Script Shadow](https://scriptshadow.net/about): About page detailing Script Shadow's mission and founder story

## Screenplay Reviews & Analysis

- [Screenplay Review – Alex Alert](https://scriptshadow.net/screenplay-review-alex-alert): Script analysis of comedy spec Alex Alert with Sony connection
- [Screenplay Review – Commando 2](https://scriptshadow.net/screenplay-review-commando-2): Screenplay analysis of Commando 2 action film sequel
- [Screenplay Review – Bad Memories](https://scriptshadow.net/screenplay-review-bad-memories): Script review of supernatural mystery Bad Memories by Julian Simpson

## Screenwriting Guides & Craft

- [So You Want to Write an HBO Show](https://scriptshadow.net/so-you-want-to-write-an-hbo-show): Guide to writing for HBO with analysis of Game of Thrones and storytelling craft
- [Knight of The Impossible Awesome Character Creations](https://scriptshadow.net/knight-of-the-impossible-awesome-character-creations): Character analysis of Knight of the Seven Kingdoms and storytelling techniques

## AI & Writing Tools
